items.source: Returns a default Jackson JsonMapper instance customized with DeserializationFeature.FAIL_ON_TRAILING_TOKENS disabled and the Jackson modules found by instantiateAvailableModules() configured.
items.translation: 返回一个默认的 Jackson JsonMapper 实例，该实例已禁用DeserializationFeature.FAIL_ON_TRAILING_TOKENS，并配置了通过instantiateAvailableModules()找到的 Jackson 模块。

items.source: Return the Jackson modules found by MapperBuilder.findModules(ClassLoader) using JDK ServiceLoader facility.
items.translation: 返回通过 JDK ServiceLoader 设施发现的 Jackson 模块，这些模块由 MapperBuilder.findModules(ClassLoader) 找到。

items.source: The default JsonMapper returned by getDefaultJsonMapper() can be customized via the automatic discovery of services of type JacksonModule by JDK ServiceLoader facility.
items.translation: 通过 JDK ServiceLoader 设施自动发现类型为 JacksonModule 的服务，可以自定义由 getDefaultJsonMapper() 返回的默认 JsonMapper。
